svg.text: PR evidence - GUMROAD-1QS: bound the grouped-receipt load
issue: https://gumroad-to.sentry.io/issues/7750062023/ (same stack as GUMROAD-1KM, 39 events since 2026-09-14)
branch: gumclaw/g1qs-grouped-receipt-load-bound file: app/mailers/customer_mailer.rb
1. Production replica measurement (read-only, 2026-09-23)
One buyer email matches 31,964 successful purchases. Every id its caller matched is passed to
CustomerMailer, and the unbounded load dies at the session's 300s max_execution_time.
$ Purchase.where(id: <31,964 ids>).all_success_states_including_test.order(id: :desc)
.includes(charge: [:order, :seller]).to_a
-> killed at the 60s statement cap (the production event fires exactly 300s after the last
SQL breadcrumb, matching the 300000ms ceiling on the connection)
$ the shipped chain -> where(id: ids).all_success_states_including_test
.order(id: :desc).limit(200).includes(charge: [:order, :seller]) + id cursor
1,344-purchase buyer: 1 window -> 110 chargeables in 0.53s
4,510-purchase buyer: 1 window -> 52 chargeables in 0.12s
653-purchase buyer: 2 windows -> 23 chargeables in 0.12s (the email shows at most 20)
2. Why one flat window is not enough (read-only replica, 2026-09-23)
$ SELECT charge_id, COUNT(*) FROM charge_purchases GROUP BY charge_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1
-> 224 purchases in ONE charge
$ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT charge_id FROM charge_purchases GROUP BY charge_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) t
-> 285,422 charges hold more than 10 purchases (68,291 hold more than 20)
So a fixed 200-purchase window is not 10x headroom: those rows collapse into a handful of
chargeables, and receipts the window never reached are silently left out.
$ a buyer with 246 successful purchases:
flat newest-200 window -> 13 chargeables full match -> 15 chargeables
-> the flat window dropped 2 of that buyer's receipts (Greptile P1, confirmed on live data).
-> the shipped read walks 2 windows for that buyer and renders all 15.
3. Red -> green, and what the new examples catch
$ DISABLE_SPRING=1 CI=1 bundle exec rspec spec/mailers/customer_mailer_spec.rb
-> 137 examples, 0 failures (43.3s)
the 2 failures the first round recorded (spec:683, spec:1466) do not reproduce under CI=1
$ mutant: GROUPED_RECEIPT_READ_WINDOWS.times -> 1.times (stop at one window)
-> 3 examples, 2 failures (window budget and shared-charge examples bite)
$ mutant: drop all_success_states_including_test from the window scope
-> 3 examples, 1 failure (the failed-purchase budget example bites)
4. Effect on the rendered email
Windows page over SUCCESSFUL purchases, so failed rows (any callers pass) cannot spend the read
budget; the read stops as soon as 20 renderable chargeables are reachable, and no later than ten
windows (2,000 purchases, a hundred times what the template can show). Receipt blocks still come
from their chargeable, newest last, capped at GROUPED_RECEIPT_MAX_CHARGEABLES = 20.
